analysis.summary: Sonam Limited reported its financial performance for H1 FY27, highlighting a significant increase in revenue from operations, EBITDA, and profit after tax compared to the corresponding period of the previous financial year. Management emphasized its continued focus on strengthening product portfolio, operational capabilities, financial discipline, and long-term business growth. The company operates from its manufacturing facility in Morbi, Gujarat, offering a diverse range of clocks, clock parts, and calculators with established domestic and international distribution. Furthermore, the company detailed key financial figures, operational metrics, and geographical revenue bifurcations within the presentation. Sonam Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 financial performance with significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by strong operational performance and new product launches.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a full-year growth of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: Yes, we hope that 25% to 30% growth will be sustained.

guidance.claim: Management expects next quarter revenue to be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.
guidance.quote: For the next quarter we hope that revenue will be around Rs. 40 crores to Rs. 50 crores minimum.

demand_outlook.claim: The first quarter of FY27 reflected strong operational performance and robust demand across the product portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: The 1st Quarter of FY’27 has been an increasing start to the financial year, reflecting strong operational performance, deadly demand across our product portfolio and our continuing commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

demand_outlook.claim: Export demand is experiencing a slight impact due to price increases.
demand_outlook.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has recently started selling through B2C platforms such as Flipkart and Amazon.
demand_outlook.quote: In B2C, I have started in just a few months. Flipkart, Amazon.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin stood at 6.07% in H1 FY27 compared with 7.73% in H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA margin stood at 6.07%, compared with 7.73% in the corresponding period last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 8.06% and a PAT margin of 4.49%, reflecting our continued focus on operation efficiency, disciplined cost management and sustainable profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Margins fluctuate due to daily increases and decreases in raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: Margin side is fluctuating because daily raw material price is increasing and decreasing. So, the margin is fluctuating a bit.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at 60% to 70%.

capital_allocation.claim: Dividend paid (including corporate dividend tax) amounted to 120.10 lakhs for the period ending 30-09-2026.
There are no requirements for additional borrowing to fund future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports have been impacted to some extent due to an increase in prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a little bit impact on export because export is going down due to the increase in price.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to develop and sell clocks in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 in the year 2027-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, our segment, our market planning is we will sell clock in the range of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 10,000 and develop such items in this year, 2027-28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
